questions.question: ₹ 21,000 is divided among A, B and C in such a way that the shares of A and B are in the ratio 2 : 3, and those of B and C are in the ratio 4 : 5. The share of B is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Here, A/B = 2/3 and B/C = 4/5

Take all ratios to the proper place and fill the blank section with the respective ratio value as given below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3bd72bda3e52c7135ed42370cd3a3031db783374b3e6385834cf6ae774c6ab48.png] 

After multiplying we get, A : B : C = 8 : 12 : 15

So, B's share = (12/35) × 21000 = ₹ 7200

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total amount = ₹ 21000

A : B = 2 : 3

B : C = 4 : 5

**Calculation:**

Here, A/B = 2/3 and B/C = 4/5

⇒ (A)/(B)=(2)/(3)×(4)/(4) and (B)/(C)=(4)/(5)×(3)/(3)

⇒ A/B = 8/12 and B/C = 12/15

⇒ A : B : C = 8 : 12 : 15

Let, A's share = 8x

B's share = 12x

C's share = 15x

So, 8x + 12x + 15x = 21000

⇒ 35x = 21000

⇒ x = 21000/35

⇒ x = 600

∴ B's share = 12 × 600 = ₹ 7200

**∴ The share of B is ₹ 7200**

questions.question: A town with literacy rate of 85% has a population of 2500. If male population is 55%, and 92% of them are literate, then find the literacy rate of females in the town.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total population: 2500

The percentage of literacy = 85%

The percentage of male population = 55%

The percentage of literacy of men = 92%

**Calculation:**

The percentage of female population = (100 - 55)% = 45%

The total number of literate = 2500 × (85/100) = 2125

So, The number of male = 2500 × (55/100) = 1375

The number of female = 2500 - 1375 = 1125

The number of men literate = 1375 × (92/100) = 1265

So, the number of female literate = 2125 - 1265 = 860

The female literacy percentage = (860/1125 ) × 100 = 76(4)/(9)%

questions.question: What will be the compound interest on a sum of ₹ 15,000 at the interest rate of 8% per annum in one year, interest compounded semi-annually?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The total amount = ₹ 15000

Rate of interest = 8% (interest compounded semi-annually)

Time = 1 year

**Formula used:**

Compound Interest semi-annually,

Compound Interest = P (1+(r/2)/(100) )²t-P

Where, P = Principal amount

r = Interest rate

t = Time (years)

**Calculation:**

The total compound interest = 15000 (1+(8/2)/(100) )²×¹-15000

= 15000 (1+(4)/(100) )²-15000

= [15000 × (104/100) × (104/100)] - 15000

= 16224 - 15000

= 1224

**∴ The compound interest will be ₹ 1224**

questions.question: During a festival season, an electric gadget marked at ₹ 5,000 is offered on sale at ₹ 4,250 after giving a certain discount. If discount percentage is reduced by 5%, at what price the electric gadget will be available to customers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

According to the question, the discount percentage is reduced by 5%

So, The increase in selling price = 5% of the market price.

The final selling price = 4250 + [5000 × (5/100)] = 4250 + 250 = ₹ 4500

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Market price = ₹ 5000

Selling price = ₹ 4250

Discount reduced = 5%

**Formula used:**

Discount = M.P. - S.P.

Discount% = (Discount/M.P.) × 100

Where, M.P. = Market price

S.P. = Selling price

**Calculation:**

The initial discount = 5000 - 4250 = ₹ 750

The discount percentage = (750/5000) × 100 = 15%

The final discount = (15 - 5)% = 10%

The final selling price = (100 - 10)/100 × 5000 = ₹ 4500

**∴ The electric gadget will be available to customers at ₹ 4500**

Total number of chairs = 10

Selling price = (100 + Profit%)/100 × Cost price

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 4 : 5. If 2 is subtracted from the first number and 2 is added to the second number, then their ratio 2 : 3. The difference between the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The initial ratio of two numbers = 4 : 5

The final ratio of two numbers = 2 : 3

**Calculation:**

Let, two numbers are 4x and 5x

The difference of the numbers = 5x - 4x = x

So, (4x - 2)/(5x + 2) = 2/3

⇒ 12x - 6 = 10x + 4

⇒ 12x - 10x = 4 + 6

⇒ 2x = 10

⇒ x = 10/2 = 5

**∴ The difference between the two numbers is 5**

questions.question: 6 men can complete a work in 64 days. 24 women can complete the same work in 32 days. 16 men and 24 women together worked for 12 days, after which 8 men and 8 women were dropped. In how many days the work will be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Total time taken by 6 men to complete the work = 64 days

Total time taken by 24 women to complete the work = 32 days

**Formula used:**

Total work = Total efficiency × Total time

**Calculation:**

Let, M = Man and W = Woman

So, 6M × 64 = 24W × 32

⇒ M/W = 2/1

∴ A man can do in a day = 2 work

∴ A woman can do in a day = 1 work

Total work = (24 × 1) × 32 = 768

The total work by 16 men and 24 women for 12 days = [(16 × 2) + (24 × 1)] × 12

= 12 (32 + 24)

The total work done by 8 men and 16 women for one day = (8 × 2) + (16 × 1) = 32 [∵ 8 men and 8 women are droped]

Suppose, the total time is taken by 8 men and 16 women = x

Then, 12 (32 + 24) + 32x = 768

⇒ (12 × 56) + 32x = 768

⇒ 32x = 768 - 672

⇒ 32x = 96

⇒ x = 96/32 = 3

∴ Total required time = 12 + 3 = 15 days

**∴ The work will be completed in 15 days.**

questions.question: Eight metallic spheres of radius 1 cm are melted to form one sphere. The radius of the resulting sphere is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

Let, r = Radius of a small sphere

R = Radius of the big sphere

We know that the volume of a sphere = (4/3)π(radius)3

So, R³ = r³ × 8 [∵ (4/3)π will be negligible]

R3 = 8 [∵ r = 1 cm]

R = 2 cm

∴ The radius of the resulting sphere is 2 cm

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The radius of the small sphere = 1 cm

**Formula used:**

The volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³

Where, r = Radius of the sphere

**Calculation:**

The volume of each small sphere = (4/3)π(1)³ = (4/3)π

The total volume of 8 small spheres = 8 × (4/3)π

Let, the radius of the big sphere = R

So, (4/3)πR³ = 8 × (4/3)π

⇒ R3 = 8

⇒ R3 = 23

⇒ R = 2

**∴ The radius of the resulting sphere is 2 cm**

questions.question: Two numbers differ by 20. If their LCM is 240 and HCF is 20, then the greater number is :
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The difference between two numbers = 20

LCM of two numbers = 240

HCF of two numbers = 20

**Formula used:**

Product of two numbers = HCF × LCM

**Calculation:**

Let, a number = x

Another number is = x + 20

So, x × (x + 20) = 20 × 240

⇒ x² + 20x = 4800

⇒ x2 + 20x - 4800 = 0

⇒ x2 + 80x - 60x - 4800 = 0

⇒ x (x + 80) - 60 (x + 80) = 0

⇒ (x - 60) (x + 80) = 0

⇒ x - 60 = 0 ⇒ x = 60

⇒ x + 80 = 0 ⇒ x = - 80 ["-" is not possible]

∴ One number = 60

Then, another number = 60 + 20 = 80

**∴ The greater number is 80**

questions.question: A certain sum doubles itself on simple interest in 10 years. At the same rate of interest in how many years it will become 3 times of itself?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

We know, Simple interest = (p × r × t)/100

Let, total amount = x

Total simple interest when doubles (S.I. 1) = 2x - x = x

Total simple interest when money becomes three times (S.I. 2) = 3x - x = 2x

Here, (S.I. 2)/(S.I. 1) = 2x/x = 2

So, time required = 2 × 10 = **20 years** [∵ S.I. ∝ Time (All other parameters are constant)]

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The time is taken for a certain sum doubles itself on simple interest = 10 years

**Formula used:**

Simple interest = (p × r × t)/100

Where, p = Total sum of amount

r = Rate of interest

t = Time (years)

**Calculation:**

Let, the total amount = x

The amount becomes after doubles = 2x

The total simple interest = 2x - x = x

So, x = (x × r × 10)/100

⇒ r/10 = 100

⇒ r = 100/10 = 10

∴ The rate of interest = 10%

The total amount becomes after 3 times = 3x

∴ The simple interest = 3x - x = 2x

Let, the required time = T

So, 2x = (x × 10 × T)/100

⇒ 10T = 200

⇒ T = 200/10 = 20

**∴ The certain sum will become 3 times of itself in 20 years**

questions.question: The average monthly pocket money of 24 girls in a class is ₹ 275, whereas for 16 boys of the class it is ₹ 325. What is the average monthly pocket money of the whole class?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average monthly pocket money of 24 girls = ₹ 275

The average monthly pocket money of 16 boys = ₹ 325

**Formula used:**

The total sum of the terms = Average × Number of terms

**Calculation:**

The total pocket money of girls = 275 × 24 = ₹ 6600

The total pocket money of boys = 325 × 16 = ₹ 5200

The total students = 24 + 16 = 40

The average monthly pocket money = (6600 + 5200)/40

= 11800/40

= 295

**∴ The average monthly pocket money of the whole class is ₹ 295**

questions.question: In a 200 m walk race, Zakia walks at an average speed of 5 km/h. She gives a start of 20 m to Veena and still beats her by 18 seconds. What is the average speed of Veena (in km/h)?
questions.solution:

Total distance = 200 m

Speed of Zaika = 5 km/h

Concept used:

Speed = Distance/time

km/h × 5/18 = m/sec

Calculation:

Speed of Zaika in m/sec = 5 × (5/18)

⇒ 25/18 m/sec

Time taken by Zaika to cover 200 m = 200 × (18/25)

⇒ 144 sec

Time taken by Veena to complete the race = 144 + 18 = 162 sec

Distance cover by Veena = 200 - 20 = 180 m

Speed of Veena = 180/162 × 18/5

⇒ 4 km/h

∴ Veena's speed is 4 km/h

If mode of the following data is 14, then what is the value of k?

11, k, 8, 9, (k - 1), 11, 12, 12, 15, (k - 1), 14
questions.solution:

The mode of the given data = 14

**Concept used:**

The mode of a data set that has a high frequency or appears more times.

**Calculation:**

**∴ The value of k is 15**
